title: APK (Android Package) signature
summary: An APK file is a ZIP archive containing Android app resources, code (classes.dex), and a manifest (AndroidManifest.xml). The magic is the standard ZIP signature 0x50 0x4B 0x03 0x04. APKs are distinguished by the presence of AndroidManifest.xml and classes.dex.
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: APK contains: AndroidManifest.xml, classes.dex, resources.arsc, res/, assets/, lib/, META-INF/.
APK is signed with a certificate (v1/v2/v3/v4 signing schemes).
APK is the standard Android app distribution format.
